meta.time_zone: Europe/Warsaw (Python zoneinfo, independent of the M function)
meta.values: Keys are DAX measure names. Counts and sums: 0 means no rows, DAX may return BLANK or 0. null means DIVIDE by zero or no rows for an average, DAX returns BLANK. Money is rounded to 2 decimals (sums are exact), rates and averages are full precision.
semantics: Signed Orders / Signed Value count only orders with a Signed Date, also without a Date filter.
Units Planned counts only orders with a Planned Install Month, also without a Date filter.
Units Installed: jobs by local Actual End Date <= Report Date; the Date filter on Orders is removed.
Order Value PY without filters = Order Value of 2025 (the year before the whole Date table).

Order Value YTD window: 1 Jan of the year of the last date in context .. min(that date, Report Date); PY YTD: the same window one year earlier. Without filters: 2026-01-01..2026-10-28 vs 2025-01-01..2025-10-28.
Jobs and Units Installed by crew: Installations[Crew], '(not assigned)' when empty.
Jobs counts non-cancelled jobs, also those of cancelled orders; Units Installed does not.
Installation status: a job has started when it has an actual start or an actual end.
